newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Allied says Crusader to accept offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Allied says Crusader to accept offer.

text.p: Allied Queensland Coal Ltd said on Monday that Crusader Ltd has advised it that it will accept a takeover offer for Allied by Marsford Holding Co for its 43.36 percent stake in Allied in absence of a higher bid.
Marsford on October 2 increased its offer for Allied to A$0.78 a share, exceeding by three cents a rival offer by Centennial Coal Co Ltd of A$0.75 cents a share.
Clyde Petroleum Plc owns 43.4 precent of Allied by virtue of its takeover of Crusader Ltd earlier this year.
Allied has steaming coal operations in the Surat Basin.

Clyde had already said it would sell to Marsford prior to Marsford raising its offer to 78 cents a share on October 2 but it also said it would leave its sale options open pending progress in takeover offers.

Allied said it was recommending that shareholders take no action and said it did not consider it appropriate at this time to make a recommendation to shareholders whether or not to accept the Marsford offer.
Marsford is a subsidiary of Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd
